items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: Yes, I met him. I knew him. He died too.

ctx.x: There were a couple of other famous New Orleans carnet players. One was Buddy Bold.

Did you ever hear him? I don't remember him, but I do remember Emmanuel Teres. Oh, yes. Do you remember him? Yes, I met him. I knew him. He died too. I didn't hear him play. Yeah, right. He always compared me with Perry. He used to come over here. Yeah, he did. I used to show off a little bit, you know, when he'd be in town, you know, I'd make some passengers there. And he'd say, you know, those fellas there, they can't do that, you know, like you like it.
Did you ever hear Joe Oliver? They called him King Oliver later?
